caption:
Jensen Huang did not just make the front page. He got his own movie poster. 😂

Delhi Times turned the Nvidia CEO into the star of a spy thriller: leather jacket, chip in hand, a submarine in the back and the title 'The Spy Who Loved Me.' And the headline next to it? 'Nvidia is in a sticky situation-chip.' Someone at that paper deserves a raise. 💀

The real story is less funny. Huang admitted an affair with a woman US officials believe is a Chinese spy, and Nvidia's board met on Wednesday to decide whether he stays as CEO, Reuters reported. No decision has been announced.

Best front page of the year, or did they go too far? 👇
